core_claims: Nova X5 features a Tensor G4 chipset

Nova X5 display has a 120 Hz refresh rate
Nova X5 has a camera system with a 50 MP main camera
Nova X5 offers storage options of 128 GB, 256 GB, or 512 GB
Nova X5 offers RAM configurations of 8 GB or 12 GB
Nova X5 supports 5G Sub-6 GHz
Nova X5 supports Wi-Fi 6/6E

Nova X5 provides a multi-layer security architecture from chip to OS
Nova X5 offers regular security patches with a documented public schedule
Nova X5 features a built-in antivirus engine that scans apps hourly
Nova X5 features advanced computational photography powered by the Tensor G4 NPU
Nova X5 offers real-time AI tools such as live translation and smart image processing
Nova X5 integrates hybrid on-device and cloud-based AI for select tasks

Nova X5 supports 30–45W USB-C fast charging
Nova X5 does not support expandable storage via microSD
Nova X5 offers internal storage options of 128 GB, 256 GB, or 512 GB UFS 3.1
Nova X5 delivers a clean, bloatware-free Android experience

Nova X5 is designed for consistent long-term software performance
Nova X5 provides a reliable patch cadence
Nova X5 provides a pure Android experience
disclaimers: Actual battery life and performance may vary over the 7-year support period
